import Base

# The 3x3 box rolls by columns. B3/S23 is box=3 or box-focus=3.
def Life.stencil(
  +here: List<&2, U32>,
  +north: List<&2, U32>,
  +south: List<&2, U32>,
  west: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match here:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> eastward:
      n = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, north), 0)
      ne = Maybe.default(
        &2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, List.tail(&2, U32, north)), 0)
      e = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, eastward), 0)
      s = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, south), 0)
      se = Maybe.default(
        &2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, List.tail(&2, U32, south)), 0)
      +middle = (n + cell + s : U32)
      east = (ne + e + se : U32)
      +box = (west + middle + east : U32)
      Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
        U32.is_eq(box, 3),
        U32.is_eq((box - cell : U32), 3))) <>
        Life.stencil(
          eastward,
          List.tail(&2, U32, north),
          List.tail(&2, U32, south),
          middle)

# Here becomes north while the unconsumed suffix reveals south.
def Life.sweep(
  height: Nat,
  +width: Nat,
  +cells: List<&2, U32>,
  north: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+more:
      +here = List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
      +below = List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width)
      south = List.take(&2, U32, below, width)
      List.append(
        &2,
        U32,
        Life.stencil(here, north, south, 0),
        Life.sweep(more, width, below, here))

# Nil seeds the top halo; exhausting the suffix supplies the bottom halo.
def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  Life.sweep(
    U32.to_nat(height),
    U32.to_nat(width),
    cells,
    Nil{})

# Zero is identity; each successor composes one synchronous spatial step.
def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: The repeated boxes, mirrored neighborhoods, and alternately present or absent centers suggest treating each neighborhood as one rolling inclusive 3x3 box. The concrete improvement hypothesis is that B3/S23 becomes more immediate and memorable when its two cases collapse algebraically: the next cell is alive exactly when either the inclusive box contains three live cells or the same box with its focus removed contains three.
findings: No semantic finding was present: the prior revision passed all behavioral, composition, backend, and semantic checks. The style finding is confirmed. This revision preserves the validated streaming stencil but replaces the explicit survival-versus-birth branch with the single relationship box=3 or box-focus=3, and sharpens the spatial and temporal invariants at Life.sweep, step, and evolve.
